description: Database for UHPC Simulations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). This dataset includes the MATLAB scripts used to code the Softened Membrane Model for Ultra-High-Performance Concrete (SMM-UHPC). The SMM-UHPC is an extension of the SMM originally developed to simulate the in-plane shear behavior of reinforced concrete members. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Ultra-High-Performance Concrete (UHPC), Softened Membrane Model (SMM), Concrete Shear, Membrane Elements, Universal Panel Tester.. Published 2024-04-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
